working_definition: Author grouped type Tm5ab (transmedullary neurons Tm5a plus Tm5b) of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas, at the developing pupal stages P15/P30/P40 (~15-40 h APF), where cells are immature neurons.
searches_performed: ancestor walk of Tm5a/Tm5b for immature counterparts
'immature transmedullary neuron Tm5' (new term, FBbt fbbt/releases/2026-11-02)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult transmedullary neuron Tm5 (Özel et al., 2021).

justification: The group is Tm5a + Tm5b, whose common mature parent is transmedullary neuron Tm5 (FBbt:00003793); at P15-P40 the cells are developing (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage), so the immature form of that common parent, FBbt:00053684 'immature transmedullary neuron Tm5' (FBbt #2219, release 2026-11-02), as a broad match.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of a transmedullary neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent of the new immature Tm5 term (used until FBbt #2219 was released).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm5b (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hbn/Opa/Slp temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Only one of the two members (Tm5a has no immature term).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary neuron that terminates in lobula layer 5 with bleb-type arborizations. It displays fine arborizations in medulla layers M3 and M6 and other, depending on the subtype. It has bleb-type terminals in layers M6 and M8. It has three subtypes.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature term; the stage is developing (P15-P40), which takes immature terms.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053684 'immature transmedullary neuron Tm5' (broad match).
